subject: Metering window change and monthly true-up cadence for BrightApps launch
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha@brightapps.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightapps.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: metering window change + monthly true-up cadence for upcoming launch

Hi Aditya,

We're ramping to a public feature launch that will hit our LLM usage hard for a 10-day period starting 2027-05-10. Based on our internal forecasts we expect: ~120M input+output tokens/day for the first 7 days, then tapering to ~45M/day.

Quick ask: can Redwood temporarily (two weeks) change our metering to a 7-day rolling aggregation instead of strict daily enforcement and bill overruns on a monthly true-up schedule rather than immediate invoice push? The goal is to avoid throttling mid-launch and to make the billing predictable for our finance team.

We'd also like a proposal for a short-term overrun rate (per 1M tokens) and any crediting approach if actual consumption is lower than forecast. Please let us know what paperwork you need (PO, appendix, short-term SLA exception). I'll loop procurement on details.

Attached: Usage_Template.xlsx (sample daily telemetry).

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Head of Platform, BrightApps
Samantha.Green@brightapps.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@brightapps.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: metering window change + monthly true-up cadence for upcoming launch

Samantha — thanks for the heads up and the template. We're excited for BrightApps' launch. A few quick items so we can move fast: 

1) Confirm exact launch window dates (start/end) and an expected peak day so we can size a temporary uplift.
2) We can support a rolling 7-day aggregation for quota enforcement as a short-term policy during the window. That prevents day-to-day spikes from triggering hard throttles.
3) Billing cadence: we can do a monthly true-up (invoices issued on the 1st after month close) for the overrun portion, provided we have a signed appendix & a PO referencing the appendix.

Pricing approach proposal (initial):
- Temporary overrun rate: $60 per 1M tokens (input+output) during the temporary window.
- Pro-rated calculation: overrun = usage above committed monthly allowance aggregated over the month; charged at overrun rate on monthly invoice.
- If total actual overrun for the month is less than forecasted, we will credit the difference on the following invoice (no retroactive refunds beyond that month).

I've attached a short draft: Proposed_Appendix_v1.pdf — it includes the metering-window language, required PO wording, and a simple decimalized overrun calculator. Monica, Jordan — can you confirm the feasibility from ops and billing (SLA implications / invoice fields)?

Next steps: if procurement is ok, we'll produce a DocuSign appendix and ask for a short-form PO referencing HS-72394.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: procurement@brightapps.com
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, samantha.green@brightapps.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: metering window change + monthly true-up cadence for upcoming launch

Hi Aditya / Samantha,

Procurement here. A few gating items before we can sign an appendix: 

• We need a PO reference format (our finance system requires: BR-<vendor>-<YYMMDD>-<seq>).
• Please provide a short form statement of work (1 paragraph) and the appendix as a redline-ready docx.
• We need line-item invoice detail for the overrun charges (date ranges, token bands, unit price, total).
• Cap request: BrightApps is willing to accept overrun billing but requires an upper cap on monthly overrun charges for the first two months. Proposal: cap = 1.5x our committed monthly spend.

Attached: vendor_addendum.docx (our procurement team's template). We'd prefer the DocuSign flow. If Redwood can accept the cap, we can issue an expedited PO.

Thanks,
BrightApps Procurement
procurement@brightapps.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@brightapps.com, samantha.green@brightapps.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: metering window change + monthly true-up cadence for upcoming launch

Procurement team — appreciate the clear asks. Summary / Redwood response below (quoting key lines):

> "We need a PO reference format (BR-<vendor>-<YYMMDD>-<seq>)."
We can accept that PO format — please put BR-BRIGHT-20270510-01 (example).

> "We need line-item invoice detail for the overrun charges (date ranges, token bands, unit price, total)."
We'll include a per-invoice breakdown that lists: date-range, committed allowance, actual usage, overrun (tokens), unit price per 1M tokens, and line total. Monica — billing will ensure the CSV is attached to the invoice.

> "Cap request: cap = 1.5x committed monthly spend."
To close quickly we can accept a temporary cap but ask for 1.25x the committed monthly spend as a compromise (this keeps the risk envelope manageable for Redwood while giving BrightApps predictability). If you need 1.5x, we'll require a short credit-hold escrow (one invoice cycle) to mitigate risk. Please let us know which option you prefer.

Action items and attachments: 
- Attached: May_Projected_Usage.csv (internal forecast we used to estimate the uplift).
- Next step: If procurement agrees to 1.25x cap (or to the escrow arrangement for 1.5x), we'll generate the appendix in DocuSign (link below) and a short SOW paragraph for the PO.

DocuSign preview: https://redwoodai.app/docusign/ABC-72394
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/72394

Please reply with: (A) confirmed launch dates, (B) preferred cap option (1.25x or 1.5x + escrow), and (C) PO reference when ready.

Thanks — we'll standby to expedite the DocuSign and enable the rolling 7-day metering enforcement on the start date you confirm.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
